about_the_game:
DOLJNIK is a first-person comedy horror game in which the player's attention is paid to creating a comedic, but at the same time somewhat creepy atmosphere. You basically have to wander around the house, completing quests. In total, the game has several locations that differ from each other.Your main task is to get rid of the loan, but as well as how well you can do it, you also need to skillfully conduct dialogues with collectors and various strangers who will meet you on the way. 

————————

What's so special about this game?

- The plot

-Dialogues

- Humor 

-Unique tasks

-A content-filled world.

-Atmosphere

AND SO ON

In the story, you are an ordinary man who lived in the 90s in Eastern Europe on the ruins of a great superpower. At this time, crime and lawlessness reign as never before. They took out a loan on your mother, and she died from pressure from the collectors. You went to live in her house and came face to face with evil yourself. According to the rules of Honest Bank, in the event of the debtor's death, the debt is inherited. Now you are the new victim of Honest Bank, but you do not plan to give up and stand up to it.

On your way there are many interesting dialogues with different people and exploring this world, which is not as simple as it seems at first glance. There are a lot of jokes in the game, both funny and not so funny. In general, the game is for an hour in the evening after the factory.

————————

The game is fiction and has nothing to do with reality, any coincidences with real events or personalities are completely random. The game features a fictional world. The game does not encourage anyone to do anything, does not promote anything, and also does not aim to offend or humiliate anyone.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains images of violent scenes that can have a negative impact on the psyche. Please also keep in mind that there are scenes of drinking or smoking in the game. Some content elements may not be suitable for certain age categories. A reasonable limitation of the game's audience is recommended.
The game contains flashes of light that can cause epileptic seizures.
